title: Confirm Hub71 acceptance
detail: Your acceptance is the starting point for every Hub71 benefit.

title: Arrange your company licence
detail: Licence your company so it can sponsor visas and sign contracts.

title: Arrange your establishment card
detail: Lets your company sponsor your visa and your team's.

title: Arrange your founder visa
detail: Unlocks your entry permit and the rest of your settling-in map.

title: Confirm your Hub71 incentives
detail: Ask Hub71 which incentives apply to your programme and how to claim them.

title: Set up in your Hub71 workspace
detail: Ask Hub71 which workspace options come with your programme.

title: Relocate your first hires
detail: Invite hires so each one gets their own map, and track their progress.

title: Join Hub71 community sessions
detail: Ask Hub71 about upcoming sessions, mentors and partner access.
